status: PROPOSAL - no code submitted, no parameter change proposed for immediate merge
frozen: Phase A artifacts and canary chunks (155) are frozen and untouched
no retrieval parameter tuning: vector_similarity_weight, similarity_threshold, routes_top_k, reranker, tokenizer/analyzer, metadata/header/profile, embedding model, KB index
no KB index writes, no Redis mutation
governing_principles: graceful degradation allowed, silent degradation forbidden
corpus independence: no domain vocabulary in rules, gates or tests

items.title: Retrieval health contract (versioned, additive)
items.deliverable: retrieval_health schema with schema_version, overall in full/degraded/failed, per-leg status (decomposition, dense, lexical, rerank, followup), enumerated reason codes, evidence completeness, alerts
rules: unknown leg status is never full
no extra queries, retries or index operations

items.title: Producer and aggregation points
items.deliverable: per-route outcome captured where routes are isolated and at the recall-floor rescue; aggregated in the retrieval entry point beside chunks, doc_aggs and total
depends_on: P1-1 for plan identity and validation outcome

items.title: Propagation to trace, metrics and synthesis
items.deliverable: one structured event per retrieval; counters per leg and reason; trace attributes; health passed to the answer layer as a constraint
acceptance: dense-leg failure alarms without waiting for a customer
single request explainable end to end

items.title: Answer-layer policy under degraded evidence
items.deliverable: two-tier policy: narrative questions answer with disclosure; numeric-constraint questions refuse or mark unverified; failed retrieval never produces an answer
items.invariant: an answer may never assert hybrid-evidence confidence when a leg has failed
acceptance: disclosure assertions pass on injected failures

items.title: Fault-injection verification harness
items.deliverable: test doubles at the embedding boundary injecting quota error, timeout, partial route failure and total failure
acceptance: status and reason codes correct per injection

items.title: RetrievalPlan schema
items.deliverable: plan_version, intent enum, source provenance, normalised question, ordered sub_queries with targets, constraints, validation result, determinism block
rules: rejected plan replaced by deterministic pass-through plan and reported as PLAN_VALIDATION_FAILED
acceptance: plan identity usable as cache and health key

items.title: Determinism contract for the planner
items.deliverable: pin sampling where supported (temperature 0, explicit seed), canonical dedupe and stable first-mention order, schema validation, then cache validated plans keyed on plan_version + normalised question + model id
items.reframe: the cache's documented role becomes performance optimisation; reproducibility becomes a proven property instead of a cache-lifetime accident
acceptance: cache hit and miss provably identical in plan, routes and window

items.title: Plan cardinality floor
items.deliverable: empty or rejected plan degrades to the deterministic pass-through plan
acceptance: zero sub-queries is never a terminal state

items.title: Two-stage gate with corpus-independent features
items.deliverable: stage 1 deterministic structural check outputting not_composite/composite/uncertain; stage 2 optional model confirmation for uncertain only, under the P1-2 determinism contract
acceptance: identical behaviour on a transformer datasheet and a software specification

items.title: Gate test suite (offline, de-identified)
items.deliverable: synthetic queries in six structure classes (single_fact, numeric_constraint, comparison, multi_hop, ambiguous, procedural) with expected labels; offline tier runs in CI without model or embedding; second tier measures plan quality

items.title: Route-set stability reporting
items.deliverable: per retrieval: route set, which pool-dependent branches fired (recall-floor rescue, core-document follow-up)
items.rationale: makes amplification visible instead of inferable

items.title: Deterministic tie-breaker at all three ordering sites
items.deliverable: fixed secondary key (stable chunk/document id, ascending) at the cross-route merge, the rank-adjusted selection sort and the store-side sort; application-imposed order after fusion because an approximate kNN clause offers no tie-break parameter
items.status_change: LATENT TIE-BREAK RISK - NOT OBSERVED AS A FAILURE
rules: any tolerance must be a single documented constant applied identically

items.title: Tie-breaker verification
items.deliverable: equal-score fixtures across documents and shards; shuffled-input property tests; neutrality check on the frozen corpus
acceptance: no observable change except where ties existed, each change itemised with cause

decisions_requested.recommendation: pin sampling where supported plus canonicalise and validate, recording provenance

decisions_requested.decision: degraded-serving posture when the dense leg is unavailable
decisions_requested.recommendation: serve with disclosure for narrative, refuse values
approve OPGW/ADSS, transformer and software spec, read-only, Phase A artifacts untouched
test doubles at the embedding boundary, never spend real quota on failure tests
per-day budget guard and circuit breaker first; a fallback embedding model changes retrieval semantics and needs its own review

holdout_acceptance.setup: four families (existing cable corpus, OPGW/ADSS, transformer, software specification), ingested with no change to rewriting rules or retrieval code; Phase A artifacts, canary chunks and pinned configuration untouched

gates.threshold: exact window match on all repeated pinned runs
100% correct reason codes and monotonic overall

gates.failure_meaning: unnecessary model randomness at the entrance

gates.threshold: empty or near-empty window never reports full
gates.failure_meaning: the Phase A failure left unfixed

holdout_acceptance.quota_discipline: determinism and gate suites run offline; holdout validation runs inside a budget guard, and an unavailable quota is reported as BLOCKED_BY_QUOTA rather than replaced by a degraded substitute
